answer: PoA resists Sybil attacks by linking identities through correlated equivocation: when k controlled identities sign conflicting histories, the aggregate penalty scales quadratically, O(k^2), rather than linearly. Upon detection, an exponential multiplier amplifies capital loss across the swarm, draining bonded escrows and applying asymmetric depreciation. Thus a shale, opal, or vine of aliases becomes economically self-defeating.
